units.source_text: 屋檐上，雨声淅沥，恍如只有那儿在下雨。

en.t: On the eaves, the rain pattered softly, as if it were raining only there.

units.source_text: 雨点失去了扩大的能力，迷失在这条街的一角，呆立不动。

en.t: The raindrops had lost the power to spread, and, having strayed into one corner of this street, stood there motionless.

units.source_text: 这雨声犹如我所在的地方，远离了无垠的黑夜，仅局限在枕边纸灯笼的昏暗灯光下的世界里。

en.t: This sound of rain, like the place where I was, had withdrawn from the boundless black night and was confined only to the world beneath the dim light of the paper lantern by my pillow.
